sum: Fitness coach at $8K/mo working 70-hour weeks; agreed on price but left to talk to his wife.
why: Wife makes money decisions with him and wasn't on the call.

obj.q: That's a lot. Six grand is more than I make in a slow month.
obj.r: You told me waiting six months costs you sixty grand. This is six.

obj.q: I need to talk to my wife first. We make money decisions together.
obj.r: Totally understand. Talk to her tonight and let me know how it goes.

fix: When the partner comes up: "Makes sense. Let's get her on a quick call tomorrow at 6 so she hears it from me. Does that work?"

sum: New business coach with four sales in six months and four months of savings; paid in full.
why: Urgency from dwindling savings plus a matching case study.

obj.q: Honestly that's expensive for where I'm at right now.
obj.r: I'm not going to discount it, because the price isn't the risk. Staying where you are is.

sum: Coach heard a feature list, then said he needed to think about it.
why: No discovery or pain, so nothing tied the offer to his situation.

obj.q: I just need to think about it, it's a lot to take in.
obj.r: Take some time, think it over, and hit me up when you're ready.

qs.q: What's the payment plan look like?

fix: Before any pitch: "Walk me through where the business is today."
On "think about it": "What specifically do you need to think through? Let's do it now."

sum: Fitness coach at $9K/mo with no-show problems bought on the payment plan.
why: She was already looking for this exact fix and sold herself.

qs.q: How fast do people usually see results?

sum: Dating coach with launch-only revenue liked the case study but asked for info.
why: Never asked for the sale, so 'send me info' ended the call.

obj.q: I've tried a course like this before and it didn't really work for me.
obj.r: The difference is you'd have me reviewing your funnel every week, not just videos.

fix: After the case study: "Do you want to get started today?" Then stop talking.

sum: Couple running a postpartum fitness program bought on the payment plan with both partners on the call.
why: Both decision-makers present and a real deadline (second child).

obj.q: We tried a coach last year and it was a waste. How is this different?
obj.r: Last time you got advice. Here we build it with you and I review your setter's calls weekly.
